method: Image generation repair; accepted generated PNGs retained unchanged. Runtime extracts a complete periodic brick motif and scales it to its world repeat; no pixel warps, painting, seam blur, or reflective mirroring of accepted art. Sand uses the full image directly.

sourceArtwork.purpose: Red-brown clay brick and narrow mortar style reference.

accepted.promptIntent: Preserve golden granular pixel detail; replace long reflected diagonal dune bands with subtle short windswept stipple; translation-tileable in both axes, no mirror folds or visible grid.

Preserve fired clay/granular mortar palette; regular straight running bond, alternating half-brick courses, translation repeat instead of reflection; crop is two complete courses and two brick widths bounded by matching mortar phase.

sampling: Continuous world-anchored material patterns, offset by rendered elevation to retain logical x/y phase. Minification samples the full field with area filtering; shared rounded device-pixel cell boundaries prevent translucent cracks. Native scale retains nearest pixel sampling.
